headline: South Australia Premier Refers A$15 Billion Transport Project to Watchdog
summary: South Australia's premier has asked the state's corruption watchdog to investigate potential outlaw motorcycle gang infiltration in South Australia's A$15 billion infrastructure project.
why: Large-scale public civil works programs represent substantial state budgetary commitments and require rigorous procurement and security governance.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Integrity investigations can lead to tightened compliance, contractor re-tendering, or execution delays on major public works.
